title: Gideon and the Ghost
author: Casper Galloway
blurb: Emrys Sandoval, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
